Title: Payroll Element & LDG Query
Description: Extracts element name, legislation code, processing type, and classification.
CodeContent: SELECT ldg.name AS ldg_name, ldg.legislation_code, et.element_name AS base_element_name, et.processing_type AS recurring_flag, ec.classification_name FROM pay_element_types_vl et, per_legislative_data_groups_vl ldg, pay_ele_classifications_vl ec WHERE et.legislative_data_group_id = ldg.legislative_data_group_id(+) AND et.classification_id = ec.classification_id AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN et.effective_start_date AND et.effective_end_date;
